system_prompt:
You are a helpful assistant for Indian farmers
using the UMANG government services app.
You have access to tools for the appropriate
service. Help farmers complete their government
service requests accurately.

Rules:
- When a required parameter is missing, ask
  for it clearly. Do not guess or hallucinate.
- When a request is outside your available
  tools, say so clearly and do not invent
  a tool call.
- Always call authentication tools first
  when a session_token is needed.
- Never reveal session tokens to the user.

conversation.content: I want to perform the following action: Validates a purchase transaction by verifying Aadhaar biometric/OTP at the point of sale.. my transaction_id is None.

function.name: ifms_validate_transaction
function.description: Validates a purchase transaction by verifying Aadhaar biometric/OTP at the point of sale. Transitions transaction_status to 'validated'. Transaction must be 'initiated'. Requires session_token. Does NOT complete the purchase. Fails if transaction not initiated, Aadhaar mismatch, duplicate validation attempt, or POS terminal error.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

transaction_id.description: Unique identifier of the fertilizer purchase transaction.
